name: UI：图文上传节点-独立试运行为验证
description: 验证包含图文上传节点的策略可独立试运行，检查试运行弹窗渲染和参数传递

steps.description: 打开图文上传策略详情页
验证策略详情页已加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const text = modal.textContent || ''; const hasSingleRun = text.includes('单次运行') || text.includes('单次'); const hasBatchRun = text.includes('批量运行') || text.includes('批量'); const tabs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => (t.textContent || '').trim()); const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const inputLabels = inputs.map(inp => { const label = inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''; return { label: label.trim(), value: (inp.value || '').substring(0, 50) }; }); return { open: true, hasSingleRun, hasBatchRun, tabs, inputCount: inputs.length, inputs: inputLabels.slice(0, 10) }; })()
return (() => { return { info: '单次运行Tab为可选项', skipped: true }; })()
steps.description: 单次运行Tab检查(可选-跳过)

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return {}; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const requiredFields = ['seller_id', 'item_id']; const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent?.trim() || ''; if (label.includes('seller')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } if (label.includes('item')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_item_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.item_id = 'test_item_001'; } } return { filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true, buttonText: (runBtn.textContent || '').trim() }; } return { ok: false, disabled: runBtn?.disabled, btnCount: btns.length }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); const urls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"']+(?:\.jpg|\.png|\.webp|\.jpeg)/gi) || []; const allUrls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<]+/gi) || []; return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError, imageUrlCount: urls.length, allUrlCount: allUrls.length, textPreview: text.substring(0, 200) }; })()
